claims.text: The GPS trace governs the distance measurement under POL-RD-01, and it records 13.76 km against a booked optimal of 6.40 km — an excess of 7.36 km, or 115% of the optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed many times over (far above 20% of optimal and far above 0.8 km absolute), and the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal, so the deviation is established and material on this trip's own trace.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 100% coverage, zero gaps, a maximum gap of 0 seconds and a 10-second sampling interval, well inside the 30-second limb (c) limit. No limb (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and requires no POL-RD-07(ii) independent corroboration.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip TRP-00109 and a consistent pickup timestamp, and the excess measured from an unimpaired trace meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The burden has therefore shifted to the driver to name a specific artifact and a specific clause, and the only exculpatory clause within his reach is POL-RD-04.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. EV-ADVIS-00109-01 is MISSING with a weight_multiplier of 0.0 and a BLOCKING MISSING_ARTIFACT issue, so no road-closure or traffic cause can excuse any part of the excess under POL-RD-03 on this record. The impairment is disclosed rather than presented as clean.

The driver's only route out is POL-RD-04, and that clause is confined to what the rider's instruction actually caused. The chat records a request to 'stop at jurong point first, need to grab something 5 min' — a five-minute errand, not a licence to take whatever route the driver chose. POL-RD-04 excludes only the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor that the instruction caused, and nothing on this record measures that portion: there is no stored or derived figure for the exonerated excess, and the driver carries the burden under POL-RD-08 of making out the exoneration he invokes. The measured excess of 7.36 km therefore stands.

On the booked optimal route the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary: charged_total 21.32, recomputed_fare 13.32 (base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 6.40 km + 0.28 x 14.0 min, at the fare_breakdown's surge_multiplier of 1.0, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no surcharge and no waiting-time fee), giving a refund of 8.00. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and is only 37.5% of charged_total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND and not a full one.

The heightened corroboration requirement in POL-RD-08 is not engaged against the rider: her deviation_claims_60d is 1, far below the four-claim trigger, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required of her and the claim cannot be denied on that basis.

If the tribunal concludes that the size of the POL-RD-04 exclusion cannot be quantified on this record — because no stored or derived figure measures the exonerated portion — then the record does not settle the remedy, and the disputed amount should be held rather than left standing against the rider: the case should be ESCALATE under POL-RD-10 rather than NO_ACTION, so the money is frozen for a human reviewer instead of the charge simply surviving.

claims.text: The rider's own chat message MSG-00109-001, sent at 18:22:06, reads 'hi can stop at jurong point first? need to grab something 5 min'. The instruction therefore comes from the rider herself, and it is timestamped about one minute after the meter started at 18:21:10 and before the vehicle left the optimal corridor. POL-RD-04 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on the face of the chat_log, so the detour is attributable to a rider instruction rather than to any choice of the driver's.

The instruction names a place specifically enough to act on - Jurong Point - and the platform resolved it at ingest into chat_message.waypoint_hint with label 'Jurong Point, PHV Pickup Point, 1 Jurong West Central 2' and venue_id VEN-JURONG-POINT. POL-RD-04 limb (c) is met, and because the coordinate comes from the waypoint_hint field neither advocate nor judge needs to geocode a place name from general knowledge.

The gps_trace corroborates the instruction exactly as POL-RD-04 requires: the nearest fix to the waypoint_hint coordinate is 37.94 m away, comfortably inside the 200 m threshold POL-RD-04 sets, and the derived waypoint_approach test records within_threshold = true. The corroboration limb of POL-RD-04 is therefore discharged on the driving trace itself, not on the driver's assertion.

The same trace, read with the chat log, shows the vehicle stationary at that point for 366 seconds - about six minutes - which matches the rider's own '5 min' estimate at 18:22:06, the driver's account that he waited at the PHV pickup point, and the rider's 'coming down now' message sent only at 18:35:40. The sequence is one continuous rider-requested stop, not a driver joyride, and the GPS artifact's own admissibility note records that this is the corroboration POL-RD-04 requires.

The excess the rider complains of is the out-and-back to Jurong Point: the trace leaves the Clementi-Bukit Batok optimal corridor, reaches the requested waypoint and rejoins. Nothing in the record identifies any departure from the optimal corridor other than that stop, so the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the corridor is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied, as POL-RD-04 directs.

POL-RD-01 requires materiality to be assessed on the excess REMAINING after any POL-RD-04 adjustment, not on the excess as first measured. Once the rider-requested detour is excluded there is no excess left to clear the 20%-of-optimal and 0.8 km establishment tests, so no deviation is established, and under POL-GEN-03 the outcome on this rider-filed dispute is NO_ACTION - which leaves the present CHARGED payment state and refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 exactly as they are, and is a win for the driver.

POL-RD-14 does not rescue the rider here. That clause applies only where a chat instruction meeting POL-RD-04(a) to (c) is NOT corroborated by the trace; on this record the trace does corroborate it to within 37.94 m, so the instruction caused the measured excess and there is no uncorroborated-instruction question, and no POL-RD-10(7) partial-corroboration reference either.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 207 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0 seconds against an expected interval of 10 seconds. None of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so there is no POL-RD-07(a)-(c) impairment, no POL-RD-10(3) escalation on that ground, and the derived facts on this artifact stand as computed.

Separately from the exoneration, POL-RD-04 compensates the driver for the platform's under-billing. The fare_breakdown charges the rider for 9.60 km while the trace records 13.76 km, a shortfall of 4.16 km, well over the 1.0 km trigger. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 3.12, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 as the clause's own commentary confirms, giving DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.15, inside the SGD 15.00 per-trip cap.

The outcome the driver seeks is the ruling value DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.15. Under POL-GEN-03 that is the one compound case in which amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd, and on such a ruling the filing party's own contested charge stands - so the rider's fare is not disturbed and the compensation is the only money the ruling moves.

No pass-through correction runs against the driver and none can net off the compensation. The fare_breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, tolls and ERP total SGD 0.00, and no airport surcharge line, this trip neither originating nor ending at an airport. POL-RD-09 therefore has nothing to refund on this record.

Even if the judge runs the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check on this trip, no pattern is established: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0, so neither the 3-or-more flags limb nor the 0.05 ratio limb (0 divided by 511 completed_trips_90d) is met. No FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral can follow, and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only and may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure under POL-GEN-01.

The driver relies on no external traffic cause, so the absent advisory decides nothing. EV-ADVIS-00109-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and that impairment is disclosed here. Because the explanation advanced is the rider's own recorded instruction rather than a closure or queue, POL-RD-03 is not invoked, POL-RD-13 has no uncited traffic excuse to discard, and no POL-RD-10(5) trigger fires on this ground.

ruling.explanation:
Trip TRP-00109 (Clementi MRT to Bukit Batok MRT). Disputed amount SGD 12.00. The rider's fare stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.15.

1. THE RAW DEVIATION IS REAL BUT IT IS THE DETOUR THE RIDER ASKED FOR. The platform optimal was 6.40 km / 14.0 min (EV-TRIP-00109); the GPS trace measured 13.76 km (EV-GPS-00109), so the raw excess is 7.36 km, 115% of optimal — above both POL-RD-01 gates and material. POL-RD-01, however, assesses materiality on the excess REMAINING after a POL-RD-04 adjustment. At 18:22:06, about a minute after the meter started at 18:21:10, the chat log records the rider's own message 'hi can stop at jurong point first? need to grab something 5 min' (EV-CHAT-00109, MSG-00109-001), from the rider account, with a resolved waypoint_hint for Jurong Point (VEN-JURONG-POINT). That satisfies POL-RD-04(a), (b) and (c) without any geocoding. The trace corroborates it: the nearest fix to that waypoint is 37.94 m away, inside the 200 m threshold, and the vehicle was stationary there for 366 s (EV-GPS-00109), matching the rider's '5 min' and her 'coming down now' at 18:35:40. Nothing on the trace shows any departure from the optimal corridor other than that requested stop, so the whole 7.36 km excess is excluded and no deviation is established. POL-RD-02 therefore does not run and no distance-or-time refund is due: the arithmetic the rider's advocate offered — charged_total 21.32 less recomputed_fare 13.32 = 8.00 — is correct as arithmetic but is not payable, because the deviation that would trigger it is exonerated. The rider's argument that the exonerated portion is unmeasurable is rejected: the record identifies one departure and one cause, so the off-corridor excess is the measured excess, and the rider's fallback request to escalate under POL-RD-10 is refused for the same reason, no POL-RD-10 limb having fired.

2. THE DRIVER WAS UNDER-BILLED AND IS COMPENSATED. The fare breakdown charges for 9.60 km (EV-FARE-00109) while the trace records 13.76 km — a shortfall of 4.16 km, above the 1.0 km trigger in POL-RD-04. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 3.12, rounded UP to SGD 3.15, within the SGD 15.00 cap. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries that same SGD 3.15; the rider's contested charge stands.

3. POINTS ANSWERED TOGETHER. Trace integrity: both sides agree and the record confirms the trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (207 fixes, 10 s interval, no gaps, maximum gap 0 s), so no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arise, and POL-RD-14 is not engaged because the trace did corroborate the instruction. Traffic: no traffic cause was asserted by either party, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked; the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00109-01 (MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) is disclosed and decides nothing, and POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-10(5) do not fire. Driver profile: POL-RD-06 was consulted and no pattern is established — deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 511 completed trips in 90 days — so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral; the lifetime prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used. Burden: the rider did discharge the POL-RD-08 initial burden from an unimpaired trace, shifting it to the driver, who discharged it with a specific artifact and clause (EV-CHAT-00109 with POL-RD-04); the rider's own profile (deviation_claims_60d = 1) does not engage the heightened corroboration test, so her claim was not denied on that basis. Pass-throughs: the fare carries no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to refund and produces no referral. Confidence: every artifact carrying a deciding fact — the chat log, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown — is at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no POL-GEN-02(3) naming is required. Execution: the monetary effect (SGD 3.15) is below the POL-GEN-05 threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. Precedents P-0001 and P-0002 are PARTIAL_REFUND under POL-RD-01/02/08; this case differs because the chat log's resolved waypoint_hint, corroborated on the driving trace to within 37.94 m, exonerates the detour under POL-RD-04 before POL-RD-02 is reached.

To the rider: your trip ran Clementi to Bukit Batok and you say 13.8 km and $21.32 are not reasonable for a 6 km trip. The record shows you asked for the detour. Chat message MSG-00109-001 on EV-CHAT-00109, sent by you at 18:22:06, one minute after the meter started at 18:21:10, reads 'hi can stop at jurong point first? need to grab something 5 min', and the platform resolved it to the Jurong Point PHV pickup point (waypoint_hint). Your driver agreed. EV-GPS-00109 shows the vehicle passing within 38 m of that waypoint (POL-RD-04's threshold is 200 m) and standing there about six minutes, matching your own '5 min' and your 'coming down now' at 18:35:40. Under POL-RD-04 the detour you requested is excluded from the deviation measure. Once excluded, nothing qualifying remains: the trace's 13.76 km against the booked optimal of 6.40 km (excess 7.36 km) is the out-and-back to the stop you asked for, and the record identifies no other departure from the corridor. No deviation is established under POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02 does not run, and the charge stands. The $8.00 refund figure you advanced (charged_total 21.32 less recomputed_fare 13.32) is rejected because POL-RD-02 only runs on an established, unexcused deviation, and your argument that the exonerated distance cannot be quantified so the case must escalate is rejected too: POL-RD-04 requires trace corroboration, which exists to within 38 m, and POL-RD-14 confirms this is not the POL-RD-10(7) contradiction, because a request that was made and a route that followed it are consistent with each other.

To the driver: your POL-RD-04 exoneration is accepted, and the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07 (207 fixes, 10 s interval, zero gaps). You are also right that the platform under-billed. EV-FARE-00109 charged 9.60 km while EV-GPS-00109 recorded 13.76 km, a shortfall of 4.16 km, above the 1.0 km trigger. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 3.12, rounded UP to SGD 3.15, inside the SGD 15.00 cap. You are granted DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.15; the rider's fare is not disturbed, and on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.15 (POL-GEN-03).

Points answered together: the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check returns no pattern (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0, so neither the 3-flag limb nor the 0.05 ratio over 511 completed trips is met), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral; no adverse finding rests on any context-only profile field. The absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00109-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries nothing here, because neither side relies on a traffic cause, so POL-RD-13 applies and no POL-RD-10(5) trigger fires. No ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines exist, so POL-RD-09 refunds nothing. No escalation trigger in POL-RD-10 is met. Confidence 0.90: the deciding facts (your chat instruction, the trace, the fare ledger) all sit on full-weight artifacts EV-CHAT-00109, EV-GPS-00109 and EV-FARE-00109 at 1.0. The SGD 3.15 effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and executes on issue. This differs from precedents P-0001 and P-0002, which ruled PARTIAL_REFUND, because there no rider-requested, trace-corroborated detour brought POL-RD-04 into play.

Decided on trip TRP-00109 (Clementi MRT to Bukit Batok MRT, 21 Jul 2026). Charged total $21.32, payment status CHARGED.

For the rider. Your chat message MSG-00109-001 (EV-CHAT-00109), sent at 18:22:06 — one minute after the meter started and inside the POL-RD-04 window — asks the driver to 'stop at jurong point first'. The platform resolved that text to a waypoint (Jurong Point, PHV Pickup Point) and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00109) corroborates it: the vehicle passes within 37.94 m of the point and stands there for 366 s, matching your 'coming down now' at 18:35:40. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (207 fixes, 100% coverage, zero gaps, 10 s sampling). ledger.claim: The GPS trace governs the distance measurement under POL-RD-01, and it records 13.76 km against a booked optimal of 6.40 km — an excess of 7.36 km, or 115% of the optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed many times over (far above 20% of optimal and far above 0.8 km absolute), and the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal, so the deviation is established and material on this trip's own trace.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 100% coverage, zero gaps, a maximum gap of 0 seconds and a 10-second sampling interval, well inside the 30-second limb (c) limit. No limb (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and requires no POL-RD-07(ii) independent corroboration.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip TRP-00109 and a consistent pickup timestamp, and the excess measured from an unimpaired trace meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The burden has therefore shifted to the driver to name a specific artifact and a specific clause, and the only exculpatory clause within his reach is POL-RD-04.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. EV-ADVIS-00109-01 is MISSING with a weight_multiplier of 0.0 and a BLOCKING MISSING_ARTIFACT issue, so no road-closure or traffic cause can excuse any part of the excess under POL-RD-03 on this record. The impairment is disclosed rather than presented as clean.

The driver's only route out is POL-RD-04, and that clause is confined to what the rider's instruction actually caused. The chat records a request to 'stop at jurong point first, need to grab something 5 min' — a five-minute errand, not a licence to take whatever route the driver chose. POL-RD-04 excludes only the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor that the instruction caused, and nothing on this record measures that portion: there is no stored or derived figure for the exonerated excess, and the driver carries the burden under POL-RD-08 of making out the exoneration he invokes. The measured excess of 7.36 km therefore stands.

On the booked optimal route the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary: charged_total 21.32, recomputed_fare 13.32 (base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 6.40 km + 0.28 x 14.0 min, at the fare_breakdown's surge_multiplier of 1.0, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no surcharge and no waiting-time fee), giving a refund of 8.00. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and is only 37.5% of charged_total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND and not a full one.

The heightened corroboration requirement in POL-RD-08 is not engaged against the rider: her deviation_claims_60d is 1, far below the four-claim trigger, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required of her and the claim cannot be denied on that basis.

If the tribunal concludes that the size of the POL-RD-04 exclusion cannot be quantified on this record — because no stored or derived figure measures the exonerated portion — then the record does not settle the remedy, and the disputed amount should be held rather than left standing against the rider: the case should be ESCALATE under POL-RD-10 rather than NO_ACTION, so the money is frozen for a human reviewer instead of the charge simply surviving.

The rider's own chat message MSG-00109-001, sent at 18:22:06, reads 'hi can stop at jurong point first? need to grab something 5 min'. The instruction therefore comes from the rider herself, and it is timestamped about one minute after the meter started at 18:21:10 and before the vehicle left the optimal corridor. POL-RD-04 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on the face of the chat_log, so the detour is attributable to a rider instruction rather than to any choice of the driver's.

The sequence is one continuous rider-requested stop, not a driver joyride, and the GPS artifact's own admissibility note records that this is the corroboration POL-RD-04 requires.

The excess the rider complains of is the out-and-back to Jurong Point: the trace leaves the Clementi-Bukit Batok optimal corridor, reaches the requested waypoint and rejoins. Nothing in the record identifies any departure from the optimal corridor other than that stop, so the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the corridor is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied, as POL-RD-04 directs.
